content.value: Four components are inspected and three event A, B, C are defined as follows: (19) A = all four components are either good or bad,
B = At least one components are found to be bad,
C = Exactly two components are good.
(i) How many elementary event exist in the sample space?
(ii) Define above events A, B, C as set in algebraic way.
(iii) Interpret the following events: A ∩ B, B ∩ C, and A U B U C along with its set components.
